name: Skatås - Kåsjön
routeType: linear point-to-point official stage; shared/parallel corridor with Vildmarksleden and Gotaleden

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails: 3. Skatås - Kåsjön
findings: Current official stage name is Skatås - Kåsjön.
Distance 10 km, estimated time 3-4 h, difficulty blue/medium.
Surface is dirt/gravel roads and forest paths.
Stage starts at Skatås in Göteborg and ends at Lake Kåsjön in Partille municipality.
Official description places the route through Knipeflågsbergen nature reserve, over Getryggen, past Blacktjärn and onward to Kåsjön.
Stages 2-6 are part of STF Signaturled Göteborg.
Official access notes name Welandersgatan/Welandergatan near Skatås and Åstebo near Kåsjön.

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Hoodin official GPX: Etapp3_skatas_kasjon.gpx
findings: Track has 1431 raw points and 477 unique consecutive points after de-duplication.
Computed length from de-duplicated official GPX is approximately 9.731 km.
GPX metadata time observed by route-geometry lane as 2021-10-25; CDN Last-Modified observed as 2021-12-01T09:16:59Z.
GPX repeats each coordinate three times; normalization should de-duplicate before length or QA processing.

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails map API GeoJSON for Stage 3
findings: Page-embedded tokenized API returns a GeoJSON LineString matching the official GPX.
API-declared length is 10000 m.
Bare API without page token returned 401 Unauthorized; do not store page token as a stable source.

officialSources.title: Naturkartan: Skatås - Kåsjön, Bohusleden, etapp 3
findings: Page lists length 10.0 km, time 4 h, and difficulty Blå - medel.
Description matches official route: Skatås, Härlanda tjärn, Knipeflågsbergen, Getryggen, Blacktjärn and Kåsjön.
Naturkartan GPX is present and has the exact same de-duplicated coordinate array as the official WST/Hoodin GPX.

officialSources.title: Västsverige / Partille: Bohusleden etapp 3
findings: Describes the third stage from Skatås to Kåsjön in Partille.
Lists a shorter/stale value of 8.3 km / about 3 h, conflicting with current WST/Naturkartan/API/OSM relation distance of 10 km.
Useful for municipal route context but not canonical distance.

officialSources.title: STF Signature Trail Göteborg
findings: Confirms Stage 3 as part of STF Signature Trail Göteborg.
Lists the Skatås-Kåsjön stretch as 10 km but with shorter 2-3 h/easy framing.
Notes no water or food access along Stage 3 and mentions Partille Vandrarhem about 1 km north of Kåsjön bathing area.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen: Delsjöområdet nature reserve
findings: Relevant to the Skatås/start and western part of the stage.
Rules include no tenting/caravan setup, fire only at manager-designated places, no motor vehicles except permitted roads, no motorboats and riding only on allowed roads/trails.
Delsjöarna are Göteborg water supply; petrol motors are not allowed.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen: Knipeflågsbergen nature reserve
findings: Relevant to the main midsection, including the Getryggen/Blacktjärn area if the official route is overlaid with reserve polygons.
Rules include no caravans, no motor vehicles/mopeds except limited manager exemptions, fire only at designated places, no motorboats, riding only on allowed roads/trails and dogs on leash.
The Länsstyrelsen summary does not explicitly mention tenting; do not infer a tenting ban in Knipeflågsbergen without checking the full reserve decision or signage.

officialSources.title: Partille municipality: badplatser, leder, grillplatser and local rules
findings: Confirms Kåsjöbadet facilities including bathing jetties, diving tower, toilets, summer/weather-dependent kiosk, parking and accessible parking.
Partille trails page describes Stage 3 within Partille as marked with orange signs/bands over Getryggen, past Blacktjärn and to Kåsjön.
Partille grillplats page confirms grill places at Kåsjöbadet and at Vindskydd Prästtjärn.
Local order rules/public summary prohibit camping on Kåsjön bathing-place parking areas and dogs at Kåsjöbadet May-September.

officialSources.title: Havs- och vattenmyndigheten: Kåsjöbadet and Härlanda tjärn bathing-water pages
findings: Kåsjöbadet and Härlanda tjärn are EU bathing-water sites.
Both had 2026 classification excellent and latest listed 2025 sample suitable/no algal bloom during the research pass.
Kåsjöbadet page has a stale-looking profile field saying next update 2016-03-21; use current sample/classification data but recheck in bathing season.

camping.summary: Stage 3 should not be modeled as wild-camping friendly without further verification. Delsjöområdet explicitly bans tenting; Kåsjön bathing-place parking areas ban camping; Knipeflågsbergen summary bans caravans but does not prove a tent ban.
camping.confidence: high for Delsjöområdet and Kåsjön parking; medium for Knipeflågsbergen tenting interpretation

camping.summary: Lisebergsbyn is a commercial accommodation/camping option near Skatås, not an indication of wild-camping permission on the route.

shelters.name: Getryggen / Vindskydd "Gött läge"
shelters.notes: Wind shelter/rest point with fireplace and viewpoint, built in early 2025. Field report notes rocky ground around it is poor for tents.

shelters.name: Vindskydd Prästtjärn
shelters.notes: Near-route shelter/fireplace late in the stage.

fire.summary: Delsjöområdet and Knipeflågsbergen reserve rules restrict fires to designated/manager-designated places. RSG guidance says fire-ban status must be checked before lighting any fire or grill.
caveats: Access-time snapshot on 2026-04-29: no fire ban returned for Göteborg/Partille, but Länsstyrelsen showed a forest-fire-risk banner. Live recheck required.

protectedAreas.name: Delsjöområdet nature reserve
rulesSummary: No motor vehicles except permitted roads.
No motorboats; Delsjöarna are Göteborg water supply and petrol motors are not allowed.
caveats: Exact route intersection should be polygon-checked.

protectedAreas.name: Knipeflågsbergen nature reserve
protectedAreas.relationshipToRoute: high-confidence main midsection reserve context if GPX matches official narrative
rulesSummary: No motor vehicles/mopeds except limited manager exemptions.
caveats: Länsstyrelsen summary does not explicitly mention tenting; check full reserve decision/signage before encoding a tenting rule.

dogs.summary: Knipeflågsbergen requires leashed dogs. National 1 March-20 August strict-control rule applies. Partille forbids dogs at Kåsjöbadet May-September; Härlanda Tjärn has dog ban 1 May-15 September.
caveats: Import exact bathing-place dog-ban geometry only after facility/polygon review.

fireBanAndSeasonal.summary: On 2026-04-29, Länsstyrelserna/Krisinformation fire-ban layer returned no fire ban for Göteborg and Partille, while Länsstyrelsen pages displayed a current SMHI forest-fire-risk banner for Västra Götaland.
caveats: Must be live-rechecked within 24 h before publication/use.

bathingAndWaterSafety.summary: Kåsjöbadet and Härlanda Tjärn are EU bathing-water sites. Both had 2026 classification excellent and latest listed 2025 samples suitable/no algal bloom in the research pass. Official 2026 sampling season mainly runs 2026-06-21 to 2026-08-20.
caveats: Recheck during bathing season; do not present April 2026 as fresh sample data.
Kåsjöbadet page has a stale-looking profile field saying next update 2016-03-21.

waterProtection.summary: Kåsjön is Partille's raw-water source and surrounding area is a water-protection area. Avoid spills/chemicals and report accidents/spills that could reach water immediately.
caveats: Zone-specific water-protection rules require polygon overlay.

huntingForestry.summary: No route-specific hunting/forestry alert was found. Partille says municipal land is leased to hunting teams mainly for roe deer and moose; southern Sweden moose hunting runs from the second Monday in October through February 28/29. Allemansrätten still applies, but visitors must not deliberately disturb ongoing hunting.
caveats: Exact hunting-area overlap requires Partille hunting map/polygon check and live signage review.

closuresAndReroutes.summary: No official stage-specific reroute/closure was found on WST, Naturkartan or Länsstyrelsen pages during the 2026-04-29 pass. Field reports mention a stale 2020 Kåsjön-side closure/reroute but no newer reports repeat it.
caveats: Treat as no alert found, not proof that no temporary local issue exists; recheck official pages and signage before release.

conditionReports.summary: Recent users report good/great or fair conditions, moderate difficulty, good views, not crowded and easy/paid parking. One 2026-04-01 report says no bathrooms.
conditionReports.importImpact: Do not treat toilets as guaranteed along-route; endpoint toilets are seasonal/uncertain.

conditionReports.summary: Repeated reports mention uneven forest path, exposed roots, occasional muddy sections, gravel-road portions, up/down sections and some cyclists. One 2025 report says markings were clear.
Historical closure near Kåsjön with signed reroute and winter icy/muddy conditions.
conditionReports.importImpact: Stale closure signal only; no newer reports repeat it.

conditionReports.source: A Tog's Trek: Etapp 03 - Skatås to Kåsjön
conditionReports.summary: Mixed dirt roads and forest paths; Getryggen shelter has views but rocky ground makes tent pitching hard; Prästtjärn shelter is off the main route. Notes many intersecting trails near the city, making it easy to drift from Bohusleden.
Photo report confirms the new wind shelter at Stora Getryggen is present and in use; route active with hikers/dog walkers and no adverse condition note.

conditionReports.source: Det Vilda Göteborg: Bohusleden med buss
conditionReports.summary: Kåsjön bus stop is essentially on the route; stage described as partly wild with path/gravel, lakes, cliff walls, hills and Getryggen as best view.
Easy/fine hike except steep climb to Getryggen; smooth/easy paths; likely busy near Skatås; Kåsjön bathing area usable as endpoint break.
Older track says easy to follow, pine forest, lakes, boulders, busy on nice August day and bus connections at both ends.
Older user reported poor signage around Skatås/Getryggen and confusion toward Långvattnet; aligns with many crossing trails risk.

lanes.summary: Confirmed canonical WST facts, route description through Delsjöområdet/Knipeflågsbergen/Getryggen/Blacktjärn, official access notes, protected-area context and source contradictions.
Validated WST GPX/API and Naturkartan identical linework; OSM relation 280005 corroborates closely; identified Gotaleden/Vildmarksleden overlap context.
Captured Skatås, Delsjöområdet rest tables, Härlanda, Getryggen, Blacktjärn, Prästtjärn, Åstebo/Kåsjön and lodging/access metadata with import decisions.
Identified Welandergatan for Skatås and Åstebo/Kåsjön for endpoint access, with parking and transfer hubs.
Found current 2026 good/fair condition reports and no active closure; preserved wayfinding and seasonal service caveats.
Confirmed Delsjöområdet/Knipeflågsbergen rules, fire-ban snapshot, dog/bathing/water-protection/hunting caveats and no official alert found.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Stage 3 is ready for later normalization with caveats. No targeted second agent batch needed because geometry, endpoints, access, rules, field reports and core facilities are well-supported. Remaining caveats are pre-import QA: protected-area polygon overlay, Knipeflågsbergen full rule/sign check for tenting, service season checks and route-overlap dedupe.

normalizationNotes: Preserve WST official distance 10 km and computed official geometry length 9.731 km separately.
Use official GPX as stable source; do not depend on tokenized WST API URL.
Record Gotaleden/Vildmarksleden overlap as route context and do not substitute their geometry for Bohusleden.
Cluster or de-duplicate Härlanda tjärn subfacilities and Getryggen/Gött läge duplicate objects.
